description: Independent UI slice extracted from .44.5: adapt existing LabelsLive definition create/edit and value-management presentation to stable typed Label contract (Boolean, scale min/max/increment, defined option IDs/display names, manual/automatic and percentage threshold). Reuse DSM controls from .44.10 and existing NodeRouter/Actions; no duplicate editor, validation engine, backend or folder assumptions. Preserve existing authorization/delete/rollback tests; user approved replacing optional/free-text and rejected-automatic expectations with required typed/pending semantics. Add assertions to existing tests; consolidate genuine duplicates without losing coverage. Read AGENTS.md, DESIGN.md, docs/bo-components.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, code-quality/design skills. Scoped tests and mix q; no precommit/push. Folder/source editor integration remains .44.5 after .44.4. Global legacy-value visibility is a separate pending migration decision, not new UI ACL scope.
title: Adapt existing label catalog to typed definition settings
